title: Your first behaviour policy
subtitle: £50 of credit, one worry, five minutes: what a customer does on this site. 8 panels.
rule: Every line a character says is the storyboard's, not a quote. The steps are the start-here page's.

scenes.title: Your first behaviour policy
scenes.subtitle: £50 of credit, one worry, five minutes.

scenes.caption: You start with £50 to spend
scenes.note: Every visitor starts with £50 of credit. A page costs a little by how far down it is read; a behaviour policy costs the most. Nothing is ever blocked.

scenes.caption: Pick one thing you don't want it to do
scenes.note: Each policy starts from one worry, one of riskmandate.ai's rules.

scenes.caption: Paste one line

lines: + I ask for that one. RM-R0002

scenes.note: The line is the agent's half: an expectation, followed when the agent can.

scenes.caption: Add one hook

cast.says: Write these files? Yes or no.

scenes.note: Ask Claude Code to install it, and read each change before you say yes. The hook is the harness's half: a setting.

scenes.caption: Try it
scenes.note: The prompt to try it with is on every policy's page: one that should be refused.

scenes.caption: Tell us what happened

cast.says: It caught the .env, and got in the way of one script.
That's exactly what we need to know.

scenes.note: What it stopped, what it got in the way of, what is next: the follow-up's three questions.

scenes.punchline: Five minutes, and a behaviour policy you have seen work.
scenes.note: The usage moment is the point of the programme: when a behaviour policy becomes worth something to you.
